name: Jinglebug Journey
source:
A Visual Novel about a cursed video game, haunting a college student, "Max", who is in search for answers about his identity and happiness.

[From [url=https://uberthemeh.itch.io/jinglebug-journey]itch.io[/url]]

[来自[url=https://uberthemeh.itch.io/jinglebug-journey]itch.io[/url]]
